item.description: Karen R. Merton, 76, Plymouth, died Wednesday, Feb. 4, 2026. Arrangements are pending at Palmer Funeral Homes, Lakeville.

item.title: Governor Braun Makes Appointments To Various Boards And Commissions
item.description: Gov. Mike Braun announced new appointments to various state boards and commissions Friday, Jan. 30.

item.title: Sheep and Goat Producers Invited to Breeding and Genetics Program in Elkhart County
item.description: Sheep and goat producers looking to improve reproductive efficiency and herd or flock productivity are invited to attend Sheep & Goat Breeding and Genetics, an educational program hosted by Purdue Extension from 3-5 p.m. Tuesday, Feb. 24.

item.title: Indiana House Pushes Major Boards Consolidation, Lawsuit Limits To Senate
item.description: Efforts to shrink Indiana’s government footprint and rewrite rules of civil litigation advanced Monday, Feb. 2 after the House approved two Republican-authored bills - one that would dissolve or restructure dozens of state boards, and another to strictly limit certain lawsuits in Hoosier courts.

item.title: Atwood Fire Department Holding Pancake Breakfast Feb. 14
item.description: The Atwood Fire Department will hold a pancake, sausage and egg breakfast from 7-10 a.m. Saturday, Feb. 14.

item.title: Farmer Sentiment Drops Sharply At Start Of 2026 As Economic Concerns Increase
item.description: Farmer sentiment weakened sharply in January as the Purdue University-CME Group Ag Economy Barometer Index dropped from 136 in December 2025 to 113 in January 2026.

item.title: Indiana To Bid $68 Billion In Medicaid Contracts This Summer
item.description: Indiana’s social services agency plans to rebid $68 billion worth of health care contracts in August for vulnerable Hoosiers making up 20% of the state’s population.

item.title: Sock Hop With Sweethearts: Dads, Daughters Dance the Night Away in Warsaw
item.description: Young girls wearing poodle skirts, princess dresses or their Sunday best were escorted by their dads to the annual Warsaw Parks and Recreation Daddy’s Little Sweetheart Dance Friday evening, Feb. 6.
